plan.notes: Source: HSU official 2026-2027 Degree Plans index, Recreation - Natural Resources Degree BS checklist (Catalog Year: 2026-2027), updated 04/10/2026. This is a degree checklist with a 'Suggested Scheduling Guide' rather than the standard HSU 8-semester-plan template; the term-by-term guide is transcribed. Genuine term-by-term sequence sums 13+16+13+15+12+15+12+12+6+6 = 120; all printed semester totals reconcile with the course rows. QUIRKS KEPT VERBATIM: the scheduling guide prints 'RESM 4053' for Evaluation & Research in Rec & Sport (the checklist core list numbers it RESM 40503) - recorded exactly as printed. The guide prints 'PHSC 11043 EARTH SYSTEMS AND ENVIONMENT' - recorded exactly as printed. 'X or Y' choice slots use the first-listed code. ELECTIVE placeholders use code 'ELECTIVE' because the catalog names only the slot, not a course.
